description: Call this when the user asks how much slippage a trade of a given size would face, how thick the books are, or which major perp market is thinnest right now. Returns live cost ladders in basis points for $10K to $5M market orders across 8 major perpetuals, both sides, from the full visible order book. Excludes fees; null = the book cannot absorb that size.
name: get_slippage
title: Live execution cost: what a market order really costs
